title: Andes Watchcat
description: A cat rests among alpacas in the icy Andean landscape of Cojata, Peru. Photographer Uriel Montúfar captured the unexpected scene while documenting the region’s high-altitude alpaca herders.
translated_description: 一只猫在秘鲁科哈塔冰冷的安第斯山脉风景中，休憩于羊驼群之间。摄影师乌列尔·蒙图法尔在记录该地区高海拔羊驼牧民生活时，捕捉到了这一意想不到的场景。
